verses.1: “You who expect to be faithful to the House of God, you have broken my covenant and my laws.”
verses.2: May my God cry out, for you know us, O Israel.
verses.3: Israel was abandoned; both its good and bad things were taken away from it.
verses.4: They reigned over me, but they did not sing praises to me. I did not know their wealth or their gold. They made them into idols, so that they could be worshipped.
verses.5: Your servant Zanach abandoned Shomron. They were left behind, unable to do anything at all.
verses.6: For from Israel he came forth; he was created by a godless being. He will surely become like a worm that causes destruction.
verses.7: For the wind will sow seeds, and the shoots will grow. But there will be no fruit; it will not bear any crops. Even if they try to plant strange seeds, they will fail.
verses.8: Now, Israel is being swallowed up. In other nations, there’s no hope at all.
verses.9: For those who rose up in Assyria, Ephraim gave them love and affection.
verses.10: Even though they are given power in other nations now, they still begin to act selfishly and selfishly toward their king.
verses.11: Because there were too many idols of worship for sin, they had idols of worship for sin.
verses.12: I write to him the laws of my Torah, just as they are considered strange by others.
verses.13: The gods of the darkness will be worshipped by those who are blind. They will be eaten by Jehovah. Now they will remember their sins and be punished for them. All those Egyptians who have sinned will return.
verses.14: And Israel forgot its own laws and ordinances. They built many cities in various places. I sent fire upon their cities, and they were destroyed completely.
